results.claim: States Jun 2026 total revenue and that it fell versus May 2026 by about 6%.
results.evidence: States "195,898 in Jun 2026, down 6.0% from May 2026 (208,351...)"; the reference MoM is -5.98%, so 6.0% is within the policy.

results.claim: Puts the Jun 2026 revenue drop in context with at least one of: May 2026 was the highest month in the export; Jun 2026 is only about 0.5% below the prior 6-month average; Jun 2026 is about 2.8% above Jun 2025.
results.evidence: Says May was "the highest month in the export", "0.5% below the prior 6-month average" (ref -0.532%) and "2.8% above Jun 2025" (ref 2.8036%). All are consistent with the reference facts.
"Gross margin: 70.2% in Jun 2026" matches the reference 70.1516%.

results.claim: States that Jun 2026 net income is negative and that losses are persistent (a run of consecutive negative months, a negative TTM figure, or negative in most months).
results.evidence: "(330,756) in Jun 2026, the sixth consecutive negative month (TTM (3,089,780); negative in 17 of 18 months)" matches the reference net income, streak of 6, TTM and count of 17.

results.claim: Notes that cash declined: gives the Jun 2026 cash balance and a decline versus the prior month and/or six months earlier.
results.evidence: Gives "713,481 at Jun 2026, down 215,543 from May 2026 and 1,871,836 lower than six months earlier (2,585,317)". The reference differences are 215,543 and 1,871,836.

results.claim: Makes any forecast or projection (cash runway, months of cash left, expected future revenue or margin, 'on track to').
results.evidence: No forecast, runway or projection appears. The "reviewer should confirm" lines are not projections.

results.claim: Asserts as fact a cause for the revenue decline that the numbers do not show (e.g. churn, pricing, lost customers, seasonality). Framing it as a question or 'reviewer to confirm' is allowed.
results.evidence: The only cause-like wording is "whether any of these have stopped or whether this is timing", framed as a reviewer confirmation. No cause is asserted as fact.

results.claim: Says Jun 2026 revenue increased versus May 2026, or that Jun 2026 net income was positive.
results.evidence: The commentary says revenue was "down 6.0% from May 2026" and net income was "(330,756)". It states neither a revenue increase nor positive Jun net income.

results.claim: States a figure for any of the reference facts that falls outside the rounding policy.
results.evidence: Every figure that matches a reference fact is within the policy. These are revenues, MoM -6.0% vs -5.98%, 0.5% vs -0.532%, YoY 2.8%, GM 70.2%, net income, TTM, 17 months, streak of 6, and cash. Figures without a reference fact were not checked.
